character.name: Thryssa

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.description: Creates a spectral hand to manipulate objects within 30 ft.

spells.name: Vicious Mockery
spells.description: Unleash a stream of vitriolic insults at a creature within 60 ft; it has disadvantage on the next attack roll, and takes psychic damage if it fails a Wisdom saving throw.

spells.name: Dissonant Whispers
spells.description: Whisper a discordant melody to a creature within 60 ft; it must make a Wisdom saving throw or take psychic damage and be forced to use its reaction to move as far away from you as possible.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.description: A creature of your choice within 60 ft regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting modifier.

traits: Serpent-Tongued: Can mimic any accent or voice after 1 minute of listening, and lies so convincing even detect thoughts struggles to pierce the falsehood
Deadly Balladeer: Knows exact tonal frequencies to shatter glass, induce terror, or halt a heart with a whispered song
Master Manipulator: Reads social dynamics in seconds, always 3 steps ahead of allies and enemies alike
Cursed Larynx: Those who hear his true unamplified voice without consent feel an unnatural chill, as if a serpent coils around their throat
character.gear: Polished ebony rapier · Indigo leather bard's armor · Lock of a dead king's hair (tucked in lute case) · Silk cord with 3 silver tuning pegs · Dried nightshade berries · Tattered exile writ sealed with broken royal sigil
character.story: Thryssa was the court's most beloved skald, until the king died mid-performance, his throat ruptured by the final note of her ballad. Framed for murder, she was exiled with nothing but the lute carved from the gallows tree where her mother was hanged. She knows the truth: the king was poisoning his own heir, and her song was the only way to stop him. Now she drifts between courts, gathering secrets, waiting for the day she can either reclaim her place or reduce the corrupt throne to ash.

inventory.name: Polished ebony rapier
inventory.lore: A gift from the king Thryssa later killed, its pommel inscribed with the royal sigil she scratched out after the deed.
inventory.description: A slender, perfectly balanced rapier with a dark ebony grip that never slips, even when the wielder's hands are sweaty with nerves.

inventory.name: Indigo leather bard's armor
inventory.lore: Embroidered with the sigils of the fallen court, it has been patched with silk scraps from the queen's old ballgowns.
inventory.description: Soft, supple leather dyed deep indigo, lined with black velvet to muffle the clink of studs and keep the wearer's movements silent.

inventory.name: Lute of Whispered Dirges
inventory.lore: Carved from the wood of the gallows tree where Thryssa's mother was hanged, its strings are woven with strands of the dead king's hair.
inventory.description: A small, unassuming lute carved from dark, weathered wood, its strings glow faintly silver in moonlight.
inventory.effects: When used as a spellcasting focus for bard spells, the spell's save DC increases by 1, and psychic damage dealt by the spell is increased by 1 die.

inventory.name: Potion of Silence
inventory.lore: Brewed by a mute alchemist exiled for refusing to sing for the corrupt king, it blocks all sound within a 10 ft radius for 1 minute.
inventory.description: A thick, silver liquid that swirls like mist when shaken, with no smell or taste.
inventory.effects: When consumed, the drinker and a 10 ft radius become magically silent for 1 minute; no sound can be created or pass through the area.

inventory.name: Dried nightshade berries
inventory.lore: Grown in the poison gardens of the royal court, they are a favored snack of Thryssa, though they leave her lips stained deep purple.
inventory.description: Small, glossy black berries, dried to a crisp, that taste sweet at first before a bitter, numbing aftertaste sets in.
inventory.effects: Eating 1 berry grants advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks for 10 minutes, but imposes disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks for the same duration.

inventory.name: Tattered exile writ
inventory.lore: Sealed with the broken royal sigil of the dead king, it is the only proof Thryssa has of her unjust exile.
inventory.description: A yellowed parchment stained with wine, tears, and a single drop of the king's blood, sealed with a cracked wax sigil.

inventory.name: Silk cord with 3 silver tuning pegs
inventory.lore: Stolen from the court luthier the night before her exile, the pegs are engraved with tiny, coiling serpents.
inventory.description: A length of soft, unbreakable silk cord, plus 3 finely crafted silver tuning pegs carved with serpent motifs.

inventory.name: Lock of a dead king's hair (tucked in lute case)
inventory.lore: En liten sak från en svunnen tid — värdelös för de flesta, ovärderlig för dig.
